name: trading-analysis
description: Dynamic investment research, portfolio construction, and expiring trade plans

interface.shortDescription: Turn researched candidates into constrained portfolio plans.
interface.longDescription: Validates evidence, scores dynamic candidates, constructs mandate-aware portfolios, and revalidates proposal-only trade plans. It cannot place brokerage orders.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read the research requirements, discover and research candidates, then generate a mandate-aware proposal-only portfolio plan for my review.
